questions.question_html:
Consider the following implementation of the reader-writers problem. Note that mutex and db
are shared binary semaphores, both initialized to 1.

 
What can be said about the above implementation?

A.text: A.The implementation works correctly without any problem
A.html: The implementation works correctly without any problem

B.text: B.The solution fails, as multiple readers and writers may enter the database at the same time
B.html: The solution fails, as multiple readers and writers may enter the database at the same time

C.text: C.Multiple readers are not allowed to access the database at the same time, even when no writer needs access to the database
C.html: Multiple readers are not allowed to access the database at the same time, even when no writer needs access to the database

D.text: D.The solution is not deadlock free

questions.solution_text:
Solution
(c)
The first line any reader access is down(mutex). Now mutex is taken up by this reader and is not
released until this reader is done accessing the database. So multiple readers are not allowed into
the database at the same time, even though no writer is interested in getting access to the database.
So option (c) is the correct answer.
